page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor with an x86_64 architecture operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density make it suitable for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity per compute unit without the overhead of local storage hardware.

Given its memory-optimized profile of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, the ecs.r9i.xlarge is designed for memory-intensive applications. Appropriate workloads include caching layers, small to medium databases, in-memory analytics, and enterprise applications that require dedicated CPU resources and a larger memory footprint relative to compute capacity.
